name.en: 40th Ordinary Session of the AU Assembly
name.zh: 非洲聯盟第40屆元首大會常會

city.zh: 衣索比亞阿迪斯阿貝巴

title.en: Burundi takes AU chair; water security is 2026 theme
title.zh: 蒲隆地接任非盟主席，2026主題為水資源安全

summary.en: At the February 2026 summit, Burundi's President Évariste Ndayishimiye became AU chair, with Ghana's John Mahama as first vice-chair, and leaders put water security at the centre of the year's agenda.
summary.zh: 在2026年2月峰會上，蒲隆地總統恩達伊施米耶接任非盟主席，迦納總統馬哈馬任第一副主席，領袖們將水資源安全列為年度重點。

question.en: How does water scarcity affect agriculture, energy and economic growth in Africa?
question.zh: 缺水如何影響非洲的農業、能源與經濟成長？

title.zh: 非洲大陸自由貿易區轉向落實執行

summary.en: The AfCFTA Council of Ministers met in Abuja in July 2026, Nigeria took over its chair, and the focus moved fully to putting the free-trade agreement into practice.
summary.zh: 非洲大陸自由貿易區（AfCFTA）部長理事會2026年7月在阿布加開會，由奈及利亞接任主席，重點全面轉向落實協定。

question.en: Why can signing a free-trade agreement be easier than actually increasing trade?
question.zh: 為什麼簽署自由貿易協定，往往比真正增加貿易容易？

text.en: Organisation of African Unity (OAU) founded in Addis Ababa
text.zh: 非洲團結組織（OAU）於阿迪斯阿貝巴成立

text.en: Morocco leaves the OAU over Western Sahara
text.zh: 摩洛哥因西撒哈拉問題退出OAU

text.en: Sirte Declaration calls for an African Union
text.zh: 《蘇爾特宣言》呼籲成立非洲聯盟

text.en: African Union launched in Durban, replacing the OAU
text.zh: 非洲聯盟於德班成立，取代OAU
通過長期發展藍圖《2063議程》
摩洛哥重返，非盟成員達55國
非洲大陸自由貿易區開始運作

text.en: AU becomes a permanent member of the G20
